title: Why · How · What
caption: Prompt, agent, workflow, factory: four words that get mixed up, on one timeline.

why.title: Everyone says agent and workflow, and nobody says what differs.
why.caption: <marker>The words fly around, and "factory" has no settled definition at all.</marker> So it is hard to know which one you need. <claim>Even “20x productivity” is an estimate, not a measurement.</claim>

how.title: Each layer adds one thing to the same model.
how.caption: <marker>Prompting writes instructions; an agent directs its own tool use in a loop; a workflow chains steps along a path fixed in advance.</marker>

what.title: Four Levels on one timeline, from 2022 to 2026.
what.caption: <marker>ChatGPT launched in November 2022, agents and workflows were defined in December 2024, and the factory emerged in early 2026.</marker> Play each scene or press "Play all".

claim.description: Marc Andreessen says leading-edge programmers at a16z portfolio companies are “like 20x more productive than they were a year ago”, an estimate by an investor with no method given [1]. A randomized trial measured experienced developers 19% slower with AI [2] (research AIE-0017).

why.description: Prompting, agents and workflows have first-party definitions, but "factory" is a 2026 practitioner label [1], and its definitions differ in how much human review remains [2] (research LLM-0018).

grant-dark-factories.title: Grant, Dark Factories: Agentic Software Factories (briefing, secondary)

how.description: OpenAI defines prompt engineering as writing effective instructions for a model [1]. Anthropic calls workflows systems where LLMs and tools follow predefined code paths, and agents systems where LLMs direct their own tool use [2]. Willison settles on an agent as an LLM that runs tools in a loop to achieve a goal [3] (research LLM-0018).

willison-agent-definition.title: Willison, I think "agent" may finally have a widely enough agreed upon definition

what.description: ChatGPT launched on 30 November 2022 [1]; Anthropic defined agents and workflows on 19 December 2024 [2]; the factory label dates from early 2026, and the practice began in mid-2025 at one team [3] (research LLM-0018).
